meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用工作流工具按依赖顺序分阶段运行子任务：先定义节点和依赖，再逐阶段执行；每阶段都需对照证据验证成功标准，完成后保留缓存；对失败节点可单独重试、修改指令或补发消息恢复。
howto.when: 当用户要求 mass-ulw、任务 DAG，或需要某些任务先于其他任务完成的扇出式多智能体作业时触发。硬性门槛：定义图前必须先完整阅读 references/planning.md。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 编排一个 DAG：先审计文档，再重写，最后验证。
say.note: 会按依赖顺序分阶段运行。

say.text: 对刚才的运行，用 retry 重试失败的 lint 节点。
say.note: 只重试指定节点，已完成节点复用缓存。

say.text: 用 amend 修改定义，重跑变更过的节点及其依赖。

howto.what_en: With the skill installed, Claude drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool: it defines nodes with dependencies, runs one phase at a time, verifies results against evidence, and can retry/amend/send to recover failed nodes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks depend on others. Reading references/planning.md in full is mandatory before any graph definition.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run a DAG: audit docs first, then rewrite, then verify.
For the last run, retry the failed lint node.
say_en.note: Only that node retries; completed nodes reuse cached results.

say_en.text: Amend the definition to re-run only changed nodes and their dependents.
